liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dupree's Diamond Blues** (1 review): The band had not played this song in approximately twenty years [18]
- **Throwing Stones** (1 review): The first set concluded with a particularly energetic performance of this track [18]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): The track lasted almost twelve minutes with deliberate drumming and keys [25]
- **Spanish Jam** (1 review): The audience found this performance exceptionally loud and memorable [22]

## The recordings

- **gd1982-09-20.mtx.seamons.97897.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 172 min; rated 4.86/5 by 7 [1]
- **gd1982-09-20.157809.sbd.1gen.remaster.miller.flac1644**: soundboard; 22 songs; 167 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd82-09-20.cohen.minches.19145.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 22 songs; 171 min; rated 4.62/5 by 8 [3]. Said about its sound: The audio quality is described as muddy despite the strong performance [24]
- **gd1982-09-20.163448.senn441.eaton.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 22 songs; 175 min [6]
- **gd82-09-20.set2-sbd.miller.18113.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 12 songs; 90 min; rated 4.33/5 by 3 [16]. Said about its sound: The recording sounds crisp but is pitched about a half-step too fast [28]

## Around the show

- Attendees danced vigorously until their calves ached by the end of the song [26]
- The reviewer hitchhiked from Ohio with an African diplomat who had been arrested [29]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1982-09-20.mtx.seamons.97897.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Hunter Seamons; source: Matrix mix (SBD/AUD) [1]. Also: Charlie Miller transferred Sennheiser 421 recordings from cassette to CD and FLAC; Jim Wise recorded the patch source from the eighteenth row center [1]
- **gd1982-09-20.157809.sbd.1gen.remaster.miller.flac1644**: transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  August 31, 2022; source: FLAC > DDi Codec (Dolby B) > Samplitude Pro X6 Suite > FLAC/16 [2]. Also: The remaster adjusted Dolby levels and pitch-corrected the Jim Wise patch source [2]
- **gd82-09-20.cohen.minches.19145.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Mark Cohen; transferred by Mark Cohen, David Minches; source: Audience Recording: Nak 700s> Sony D5 [3]
- **gd1982-09-20.163448.senn441.eaton.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Rob Eaton; transferred by Rob, Eaton, Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Rob Eaton's Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 441 mics > Nakamichi 550 [6]. Also: Jim Wise's Sennheiser 421 source supplies patches for Shakedown Street and Drums [6]
- **gd82-09-20.set2-sbd.miller.18113.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [16]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by wallpaperhdcornelia.blogspot.com: [Grateful Dead Madison Square Garden](https://wallpaperhdcornelia.blogspot.com/2021/05/grateful-dead-madison-square-garden.html) [31]
- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1982-09-21 Madison Square Garden, New York, NY, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1982-09-21-madison-square-garden-new-york-ny-usa/) [32]
- Poster by wallpaperhdcornelia.blogspot.com: [Grateful Dead Madison Square Garden](https://wallpaperhdcornelia.blogspot.com/2021/05/grateful-dead-madison-square-garden.html) [33]
- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1982-09-20 Backstage Pass - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1982-09-20-backstage-pass/) [34]
